subject: Zone-level stockouts
body:
Hi Priya,

Your September post on stockouts in new zones at Lumen shows a team that cares about getting forecasts right. I can help your team scale its forecasting work and grow faster in new zones.

I have 3 years of analytics experience at Fernleaf Grocers.

Would a 15 minute call next week be useful? If someone else owns this hire, a name is plenty.

Thanks,

R1.text: Lumen Grocers engineering blog, 2026-09-02: we still forecast demand per city, and stockouts in new zones run at 9%.
R1.snippet: we still forecast demand per city, and stockouts in new zones run at 9%

R2.text: Lumen Grocers job post, Senior Data Analyst, posted 2026-09-10: owns demand forecasting for new zones.
R2.snippet: Senior Data Analyst: owns demand forecasting for new zones

profile_facts.P1: At Fernleaf Grocers, rebuilt demand forecasting at store-zone level; stockouts in new zones fell from 11% to 6% in one quarter.
profile_facts.P2: 3 years as a data analyst at Fernleaf Grocers.
profile_facts.P3: Wrote a one-page note on zone-level feature selection, published at https://example.com/zone-notes
